segments.name: Gilat Defense
segments.description: Provides secure, rapid-deployment satellite communications solutions for military organizations, government agencies, and defense integrators.
segments.evidence: Our Gilat Defense Division provides secure, rapid-deployment solutions for military organizations, government agencies, defense integrators, and other strategic governmental customers, with a strong focus on the U.S. Department of Defense resulting from our strategic acquisition of DataPath.

segments.name: Gilat Commercial
segments.description: Provides advanced broadband satellite communication networks for in-flight connectivity, enterprise, and cellular backhaul to service providers, satellite operators, and enterprises.
segments.evidence: Our Gilat Commercial Division provides advanced broadband satellite communication networks for IFC, Enterprise, and Cellular Backhaul, supporting High Throughput Satellites, or HTS, Very High Throughput Satellites, or VHTS, and Non-Geostationary Satellite Orbit, or NGSO, constellations with turnkey solutions for service providers, satellite operators, and enterprises.

segments.name: Gilat Peru
segments.description: Specializes in end-to-end telco solutions and large-scale network projects, providing managed services and connectivity across Peru.
segments.evidence: Our Gilat Peru Division specializes in end-to-end telco solutions, including the operation and implementation of large-scale network projects.

revenueModel.text: Satellite operators, service providers, MNOs, system integrators, government and defense organizations, and end-users pay Gilat for ground-segment equipment sales and managed connectivity services.
revenueModel.evidence: For the year ended December 31, 2025, approximately 73% of our revenues were derived from equipment sales and 27% from services.

changes.text: In 2025, the company replaced its prior segments (Satellite Networks, Integrated Solutions and Network Infrastructure and Services) with three new segments: Gilat Defense, Gilat Commercial, and Gilat Peru.
changes.evidence: From 2022 through 2024, we operated in three operating segments, Satellite Networks, Integrated Solutions and Network Infrastructure and Services.

changes.text: In 2025, Gilat completed the acquisition of SBS, a U.S. provider of next-generation SATCOM terminal solutions, strengthening its in-flight connectivity offering.
changes.evidence: The acquisition was completed on January 6, 2025, and the initial closing cash payment of $98 million ($108 million as adjusted) was funded through a combination of existing cash resources and $60 million drawn under a new secured credit line that we entered into with HSBC Bank USA, N.A., and Bank Hapoalim B.M.
